subtitle: Scalable educational search infrastructure, high-performance ElasticSearch discovery pipelines, and interactive React.js web experiences.

projects.title: Edukhoj.in — EdTech Discovery & Search Platform
projects.shortDesc: Full-stack EdTech platform engineered with Python, Django ORM, PostgreSQL, ElasticSearch DSL, and React.js — powering fast institutional discovery, bulk data ingestion, and interactive user journeys.
highlights: Frontend & UI Engineering: Built responsive React.js components and interactive UI workflows seamlessly integrated with backend REST APIs to elevate the student and parent discovery experience.
Search & Database Optimization: Leveraged Django ORM, PostgreSQL, and ElasticSearch DSL to optimize complex search queries, bulk data management, and external dataset integrations.

Production Reliability & Agile Delivery: Monitored live production environments, resolved critical bottlenecks, authored database walkthrough documentation, and led technical handovers across agile sprints.
